release_notes: The Hikvision DS-2TD4238-4 is a thermal and optical bi-spectrum network speed dome (PTZ) with a 384x288 VOx thermal detector (4 mm lens) and a 4 MP 32x optical zoom channel. It provides temperature measurement (-20 to 150 C), fire and smoke detection, perimeter-protection analytics and smart thermal-optical tracking. Verified against the official Hikvision datasheet.

home_assistant.notes: Hikvision-platform ONVIF (default port 80). Optical is Channel 1 (Streaming/Channels/101), thermal is Channel 2 (Streaming/Channels/201).
